recommendations.action: Keep the independently authored native76 component and qualified Full identities unchanged. Renaming binders or deleting the three absent names does not resolve the full difference set.

Retain both complete compiler-source modules Ps.Foundation.Source and Ps.Foundation.List: two structures and ten functions, including numeral 0 and Boolean if. Native76 lacks the required OfNat source-literal declarations/registrations and Bool.decEq; do not rewrite or remove those uses.

Author a separate unselected candidate from coreBootstrapCandidateRoots plus OfNat, OfNat.ofNat, instOfNatNat and Bool.decEq, with empty boundary/base and no allowed assumptions. Preserve every reached dependency. Recover and independently authenticate its generated source before selection.

Measure and restore OfNat class output metadata, ordinary instOfNatNat priority 1000 and default-instance priority 100 as distinct registrations, actual declaration type/levels, reducibility and every reached native noncomputable tag. Source-derived expectations must be confirmed by the native receipt; they do not establish portable execution policy.

If literal Bootstrap/Core/Full nesting over unchanged Full is required, consider a separately generated unselected closed subset of exact frozen Full records, rooted in the complete measured workload and explicit registry needs. This is an alternative candidate mechanism, not an approved or qualified profile.

A Full-subset candidate must retain exact declaration records and all reached type/body/proof, whole-family and recursor-rule dependencies; preserve required class/instance/default/alias/reducibility/noncomputable metadata; pass finite fresh admission, regenerated descriptor/rule checks and literal Full membership. Do not implement it by runtime filtering Full or assuming the native76 root list minus absent names is sufficient.

Native76 cannot be inserted into the existing Full profile by a naming-only adjustment. Where actual workload requirements conflict with frozen Full identities, record the blocker and separately review either a checked source representation change or a versioned Full migration. This classification authorizes neither.

Require whole-source paired conversion, independent canonical admission and applicable execution checks on exact candidate commits. No successful example, source scan or declaration-only authoring result closes a Core milestone or a selfhost stage.
